priorStatuses.title: Handle missing cache entries before trimming

findings.title: [P1] Do not write issued tokens to audit logs
findings.body: Every call emits the raw credential to stdout via `console.log`. In environments that collect application logs, anyone with log access can recover active bearer/session tokens and impersonate users.

findings.title: [P1] Reject untrusted redirect schemes and origins
findings.body: finishLogin now passes returnUrl directly to location.assign. An attacker-controlled login return URL can navigate users to a phishing origin, while a javascript URL may execute in the authenticated page context. Restrict destinations to validated same-origin paths.
